items.summary: fix(agent-core): build package declarations without Promise.withResolvers (#181806) #181576 used Promise.withResolvers in agent-core's tool-batch launcher, but the package declaration build compiles against the repo's ES2023 lib, so pnpm build failed on main with TS2550 and produced no artifacts. Capture the resolver from a plain promise instead (the executor runs synchronously, and only resolve is used); behavior is identical and the package lib target stays unchanged.

items.title: fix(update): accept stale owned FTS indexes in update snapshots (#181…
items.summary: fix(update): accept stale owned FTS indexes in update snapshots (#181206) A Node upgrade that changes SQLite unicode61 tokenization (SQLite 3.54, U+FFFE) makes healthy canonical agent FTS indexes report "malformed inverted index". The candidate state snapshot refused the update with candidate-snapshot-failed before the candidate's Doctor or agent database admission could rebuild them, and its Doctor guidance was a dead end under the old runtime. assertSqliteIntegrity gains an opt-in ftsSchemas option: when every finding names an exactly owned FTS definition, the check passes, the table and foreign-key checks still run, and full-integrity admission is not recorded. Only the candidate rehearsal snapshot and update database backups opt in with AGENT_FTS_SCHEMAS. Unowned or mixed findings stay fatal. The classifier moves into sqlite-integrity.ts to avoid an import cycle. The candidate worker performs the rehearsal snapshot, so the fix applies on the first update to a candidate containing it; activation backups need the installed updater to contain it. Refs #176220

items.title: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空會員資料外洩逾1,177萬筆，近200個帳號的密碼遭改
items.summary: 日本遊戲大廠卡普空（Capcom）證實，旗下會員帳號服務CAPCOM ID遭第三方入侵，導致全球超過1,177萬筆會員資料外洩，其中有196個帳號的登入密碼遭擅自變更。卡普空表示，未發現會員自行設定的密碼外洩，信用卡資料也不在此次外洩範圍。 CAPCOM ID是卡普空旗下網路服務及部分線上遊戲使用的共用帳號。外洩資料包括會員電子郵件地址、帳號建立時間、最後登入時間、登入次數，以及最後登入時使用的IP位址，而有43筆還包含出生年月日、性別、國家或地區及暱稱。
